pair.note: Borderline: the 30-pair fixture's P11 (same pair without 'must') was judged complementary by Jev in 3/3 runs. This 'must' variant was judged contradiction once, in the jev_first_demo stage-2 run.

findings: NO stable cross-model disagreement: both judge models answer complementary consistently.
The demo's contradiction was a sampling outlier: 1 contradiction in 6 Jev observations of this pair (~17%).
Unambiguous pairs (the 30-fixture) show zero flips across runs; this borderline pair flips. Ambiguity, not model family, drives variance.
A single observation of a borderline pair must never be treated as a judgment. Repeat or require a margin.
architectural_consequence: The policy needs a margin rule: when the top-two options are close, output review instead of the argmax label. Current argmax-without-margin is what produced the demo outlier.
correction_record: An earlier report claimed a 'first real cross-model disagreement' from n=1 vs n=1. The 5x5 stability check above refutes it. The claim is withdrawn.
